s1.ptxt: After performing any one of the following services, it is necessary to calibrate electric throttle control system.

item.ptxt: Clearance of DTC related to ECM
Removal and installation of electric throttle body assembly (cleaning or replacement)

s1.ptxt: Check that the following conditions are satisfied when performing this calibration procedure.

item.ptxt: DTC is not detected in ECM.
Intake air temperature is higher than 6 °C (43 °F).
Battery voltage is higher than 10 V.

s1.ptxt: Perform this calibration procedure as follows.

attention3.ptxt: Perform “DTC clear” although DTC is not detected.

s2.ptxt: Set ignition “ON” and leave it for 40 sec. or more.
Set ignition “OFF” and leave it for 10 sec. or more.

s1.ptxt: Perform ECM Learning Procedure of Engine Torque:K14D .
